segments.he:
ו)מעשה ברבינו ז"ל שציוה לאחותו פעריל שתתגרש עם בעלה (גיסו של רבינו ז"ל) 
שהוא שוטה (ער איז אנאר) אז ער איז אנאר נארט איהם דער בע"ד אין יודשקייט איך:
segments.en: I heard from one of our fellowship a story about Reb Shneur Zalman of Liadi, of blessed memory: In his youth, after he had studied a great deal and so forth, the evil inclination tempted him — "You have already studied enough; engage a little in business to support your household, and in your old age you can withdraw from worldly vanities and occupy yourself only with Torah and avodah." And he had already resolved with himself that this was the right thing to do.
